_source: Derived from GitHub's REST docs (2026-10-04), NOT recorded from a live token: git/blobs needs Contents: write; pulls needs Pull requests: write; 403 'Resource not accessible by personal access token' when a fine-grained token lacks a permission; 422 'Validation Failed' for a head that does not exist; the expiry header github-authentication-token-expiration. Re-record against real tokens (spec 7.0).

body.message: The 'e2e-org' organization forbids access via a fine-grained personal access tokens if the token's lifetime is greater than 366 days. Please adjust your token's lifetime or request approval.
